method: Rendered HTML output of the community per-puzzle leaderboard notebook inversion/squares-in-squares-per-puzzle-leaderboard, downloaded via the Kaggle web API output endpoint; the table is embedded as `const DATA = [...]` in __results__.html. Puzzles with no team beating the starting baseline are taken from the 2026-11-11 snapshot (team="-"), since a record only exists where the baseline was beaten.
validation: 287 puzzles improved vs the 2026-11-11 snapshot, 0 regressed; implied per-puzzle best total is below the best single submission, as required.
